_about: Intent catalog for the website assistant (see CHATBOT.md). Read by inc/chatbot.php and preview/serve.mjs. Examples double as exact-match rules: a message that matches one after normalising (lower case, no punctuation) is routed without the model. Add real phrasings from the fallback log here.

greeting.description: Hello, thanks, or a sign-off with no question.
greeting.reply: Hi. I can answer questions about JIO's power, IT, security and support services, or gather a few details and fill in the quote form for you.

services_overview.description: What JIO does in general, or a list of all services.
services_overview.offline: JIO supplies and supports both IT and power: UPS and batteries, data centers, cloud, cybersecurity, networks, CCTV, managed IT and 24/7 support. One contract and one support number cover both.

service_info.description: A question about one service: UPS, batteries, solar, data centers, cloud, cybersecurity, network, CCTV, managed IT, maintenance, consulting or hardware supply.
service_info.offline: JIO covers UPS and batteries, data centers, cloud, cybersecurity, networks, CCTV, managed IT, maintenance, consulting and hardware supply. For the details of your site, call {phone} or start a quote.
examples: can you design a data center
can you set up our network
what is the difference between vrla and lithium batteries

vendors_brands.description: Which manufacturers or brands JIO supplies or works with.
vendors_brands.offline: JIO supplies around 30 manufacturers, among them APC by Schneider Electric, Eaton, Vertiv, Dell, HPE, Lenovo, Cisco, Fortinet and Microsoft. For a specific brand, call {phone}.
examples: which brands do you work with
what ups brands do you have

industries.description: Which sectors or kinds of organisation JIO serves, including government and SMEs.
industries.offline: Yes, JIO works with government, healthcare, banking, energy, manufacturing, construction, logistics, retail and education, from SMEs to large enterprises, across the UAE and the GCC.
examples: do you work with small businesses
do you work outside the uae
do you work in the gcc

process.description: How an engagement works: the steps from first call to proposal.
process.offline:
- Schedule a call at a time that suits you.
- Discovery meeting: JIO reviews your sites, loads and systems.
- Proposal: scope, equipment and a support plan in writing.
examples: what happens after i contact you
do you do a site survey
how long does a proposal take
what do you need from us

request_quote.description: The visitor wants a quote, a price for their project, a proposal, or to start or continue a quote request. Extract any of the quote details they give.
examples: how do i get a quote
can you quote for a ups
i want to buy a ups
we need a new data center
i need pricing for my project

pricing_and_claims.description: General prices, costs, discounts, certifications, licences, ratings, named clients, response times or SLAs: things JIO has not confirmed for the assistant.
pricing_and_claims.offline: I can't confirm that here. The team can answer on {phone} or {email}, and the quote form gets you a priced proposal.
examples: how much does a ups cost
what is your trade licence number

existing_support.description: An existing customer reporting a fault, outage, alarm or urgent problem, or asking for technical support.
existing_support.reply: For an outage or urgent fault, call {phone}; support runs 24/7. For anything less urgent, use the client support page or email {email}.

contact_location.description: Phone, email, WhatsApp, office address or location.
contact_location.reply: Call {phone} or email {email}; WhatsApp is on the same number. The office is on {office}.

talk_to_human.description: The visitor asks for a person, a salesperson, an engineer or a call back.
talk_to_human.reply: The team is on {phone} and {email}, or send the quote form and they will call you back.
examples: i want to talk to sales
i want to speak to a person

careers_partners.description: Jobs at JIO, or reseller and trade buying through the B2B portal.
careers_partners.offline: JIO is hiring in Abu Dhabi; open roles are on its recruitment portal. Resellers and trade buyers use the B2B portal at jiotech.ae.
examples: how do i apply for a job

out_of_scope.description: Clearly unrelated to JIO: general knowledge, coding help, other companies, personal topics.
out_of_scope.offline: I can only help with JIO's services, quotes and support.
examples: what is the capital of france

fallback.description: The message is unclear, too vague or garbled to place in any intent above.

power.label: UPS and batteries
power.send: Tell me about your UPS and battery services

quote.intro: Happy to set that up. A few quick questions, then I'll fill in the quote form for you.

slots.label: Service
slots.question: What do you need?
covers: UPS, batteries, solar, renewables, power distribution
data centers, racks, hosting, cooling, server rooms
cybersecurity, firewalls, CCTV, cameras, physical security
LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, cabling, network security
cloud, migration, IT consulting, digital transformation
several services at once, or hardware supply across categories

slots.label: Size
slots.question: Roughly how big is it? For example the load in kVA, the number of racks, users or sites.

quote.confirm: Here is what I have. Open the quote form with these details? You add your name and email there.
quote.done: The form is filled in below. Add your name, company and email, then send it.

fallback.first: I'm not sure I understood that. Did you mean one of these?
fallback.second: Sorry, I still can't place that. A person can help: call {phone} or email {email}.

unavailable: The assistant can't answer right now. Call {phone} or email {email}, or use the quote form.
limit: You have sent a lot of messages this hour. Call {phone} or email {email}.
